scenes.title: Logo reveal
scenes.start: Intact approved logo centered with generous margins on a dark green field.
scenes.movement: Reveal the complete artwork with a gentle opacity rise; artwork geometry stays fixed.
scenes.reveal: The approved lettering appears without reconstruction.
scenes.finish: Hold the full sharp logo for the last two seconds.

scenes.title: Welcome to the shop
scenes.start: Wide view of the selected authentic shop material.
scenes.movement: Travel gently left to right, retaining the established architecture.
scenes.reveal: Reveal flowers at the near edge without adding signs or people.
scenes.finish: Settle on a balanced storefront composition.

scenes.title: Bouquet hero
scenes.start: Medium close view of the selected bouquet against its actual background.
scenes.movement: A short shallow arc from right to left.
scenes.reveal: Reveal the bouquet's existing layers; preserve stems and petal count.
scenes.finish: Finish on the main bloom cluster.

scenes.title: Petal detail
scenes.start: Extreme close composition on an existing flower detail.
scenes.movement: A restrained focus pull from front petals to the center.
scenes.reveal: Bring the existing natural texture into focus.
scenes.finish: End with the flower center clear and still.

scenes.title: Customer portrait one
scenes.start: Fit the selected approved customer photo with the whole face visible.
scenes.movement: Move the photo plane gently right over a fixed matte; no face synthesis.
scenes.reveal: Preserve the supplied expression and context.
scenes.finish: Rest on the original likeness and bouquet.

scenes.title: Florist craft
scenes.start: Tight view of the selected real craft detail.
scenes.movement: Move diagonally down across the existing arrangement.
scenes.reveal: Reveal tying, wrapping or tools only when present in the source.
scenes.finish: Finish on the actual point of craft.

scenes.title: Product silhouette
scenes.start: Medium shot of the selected arrangement with breathing room.
scenes.reveal: Reveal the existing arrangement outline from base to blooms.
scenes.finish: Hold the complete arrangement inside frame.

scenes.title: Color and texture
scenes.start: Close composition across selected contrasting blooms.
scenes.movement: Traverse slowly from left foreground to right midground.
scenes.reveal: Reveal natural color relationships without changing the flowers.
scenes.finish: End on a clean two-color detail.

scenes.title: Customer portrait two
scenes.start: Fit the second approved customer image, retaining the full face.
scenes.movement: Subtle photo-plane drift left over a fixed matte.
scenes.reveal: Show the supplied person and bouquet unchanged.
scenes.finish: Finish slightly wider with the original context visible.

scenes.title: Inside the shop
scenes.start: Wide selected interior with a clear central aisle or display.
scenes.reveal: Reveal the existing display depth without inventing activity.
scenes.finish: Settle on the central flower display.

scenes.title: Wrapping detail
scenes.start: Close-up on approved wrapping or ribbon material.
scenes.movement: Short downward tilt over the existing surface.
scenes.reveal: Reveal the actual finish and material texture.
scenes.finish: Rest on the ribbon or wrap edge.

scenes.title: Seasonal bouquet
scenes.movement: A shallow opposite-direction orbit to the first bouquet scene.
scenes.reveal: Reveal existing bloom layers while keeping the arrangement stable.
scenes.finish: Finish at a clear hero angle.

scenes.title: Customer portrait three
scenes.start: Fit the third approved customer photo with face and flowers intact.
scenes.movement: A restrained two-percent photo-plane scale change; no facial deformation.
scenes.reveal: Retain the original likeness, clothing and expression.

scenes.title: Natural detail
scenes.start: Close selected stems, leaves or flower texture.
scenes.movement: Short lateral movement toward available negative space.
scenes.reveal: Reveal the source's natural structure without morphing.
scenes.finish: Finish with an uncluttered floral detail.

scenes.title: Closing bouquet
scenes.movement: A gentle pull back to give the bouquet breathing room.
scenes.finish: End centered and stable for the logo cut.

scenes.title: Logo resolve
scenes.start: The same intact approved logo on the established dark green field.
scenes.movement: Resolve from a subtle opacity rise into a still composition.
scenes.finish: Hold sharp artwork readable through the final frame; no invented contact text.

pricing.storageTransfer: Excluded; private GCS storage, retention and transfer depend on the operator's location and usage.
